column5: Plants multiple Vajra on the ground. After a while\, the Vajras will then shoot beams upward.
By enhancing her senses\, she is able to spot treasures for a brief moment. After picking these treasures up\, she can use them for spellcard attacks.
Fires a dense laser attack with the Jeweled Pagoda. It is a very dense projectile attack\, and grazing it is difficult.
Holds position for awhile\, before making a high speed charge attack. The longer the button is held\, the faster she can go.
Plants a massive Vajra on the ground. After a while\, it shoots a powerful beam attack upward.
Attracts cursed treasure and erupts them above the ground. The treasures will drain the spirit of the opponent when they touch them.
Fires a barrage of lasers with the Jeweled Pagoda. The laser converges into one point\, where it holds maximum fire power.
Spins the spear quickly. It's a quick attack that can block projectiles. It's also possible to prolong the attack by repeatedly pressing the button.
Slams the spear into the ground. It has large area\, and can hit behind her as well.
By enhancing her senses\, she is able to spot treasures for a brief moment. These certain treasures reacts to strong projectile attacks\, which in turn shoots more projectiles.
A consecutive attack with multiple combinations. By pressing B and C button\, it is possible to do attacks up to three times.
An upward knee attack. It seems to be a technique she learned from a certain martial artist.
Fires light throughout the stage with the Jeweled Pagoda. As these beams comes in contact with the ground\, more gems will be created\, which she can pick up to boost her spellcard usage.
Shoots beams with multiple Vajras spread on the ground. An attack with big coverage\, however it doesn't last very long.
An upward charging attack. It's difficult to dodge and she is invincible for a moment. A hungry tiger is difficult to outrun indeed.
Purifies the entire stage by the power of light. It's a very heavy attack which covers the entire stage. There is nowhere to run.
Fires a high-output beam attack with the Jeweled Pagoda. It's a simple and straightforward attack with high power.
Charges at the opponent upward at very high speed\, before finally making a slamming attack from the sky. It's a powerful attack\, befitting for the avatar of Bishamonten.

For a brief moment\,       strengthen the body to withstand    hits without entering hitstun\, but  cannot guard while the effect lasts. Spinning the spear lets her concentrate better\, so she starts with it.
Fires a beam attack with the Jeweled Pagoda. It may look powerful\, but she is still holding back.
Spins the spear for a moment before making a near-instantaneous movement. \The spear is not used during the charge attack itself apparently.
Unleashes a pair of massive Vajras onto the field. They rotate and covers the entire stage with their light. Dazzling and destructive\, it is perfectly balanced\, as all things should be.
